Working closely with the Executive Director, Programmes Manager, Chief Communications Officer, as well as the finance and regional programme teams, the Partnership and Resource Mobilisation Coordinator will help ensure that fundraising is proactive, coordinated, innovative and aligned with IDC’s organisational strategy and programme priorities.

The Partnership and Resource Mobilisation Coordinator will help strengthen IDC’s long-term financial sustainability by building a proactive, relationship-driven and diversified fundraising function. The role will focus on mobilising private philanthropic capital, engaging philanthropic and entrepreneurial networks, and developing strategic relationships with prospective supporters, particularly from sectors that IDC has not yet reached. In parallel, the Coordinator will explore innovative funding approaches and emerging giving channels, translating promising opportunities into meaningful, long-term partnerships that expand and diversify IDC’s funding base.

Role Responsibilities

Strategic Relationship Development & Engagement

  • Support the development and implementation of IDC’s organisational fundraising and resource mobilisation strategy, ensuring that all activities align with IDC’s ethical guidelines and policies.
  • Maintain an overview of IDC’s funding priorities, funding needs and development pipeline.
  • Support forward planning of fundraising opportunities, including prospecting, cultivation, proposal development and renewal timelines.
  • Monitor developments in the funding environment, particularly related to the mobilisation of private capital and identify emerging opportunities, trends and risks relevant to IDC.
  • Contribute to organisational discussions about funding priorities, positioning and sustainability.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen and diversify IDC’s funding base, in particular:
    • Mobilise private philanthropic capital Identify and develop opportunities with corporates, philanthropists, family offices, donor-advised funds (DAFs) and other private funding partners to broaden and diversify IDC’s funding base.
    • Explore innovative funding approaches Identify and assess emerging funding channels and mechanisms, for example, digital giving and crypto philanthropy, that could unlock new sources of support for IDC.
    • Develop impact-oriented partnerships Build relationships with funders and partners who share IDC’s mission and are interested in supporting measurable, long-term social change through strategic, mission-aligned partnerships.

Donor Cultivation and Communication

  • Champion networking and relationship-building opportunities that strengthen the organisation’s profile, partnerships and reach.
  • Coordinate follow-up, such as thank you letters and other stewardship communications, with funders and prospective funders, ensuring actions and opportunities are appropriately tracked.
  • Prepare background research, briefing materials and correspondence for donor meetings.
  • Liaise with the Executive Director, Programmes Manager and relevant team members on potential opportunities related to target funders.
  • Coordinate relevant IDC impact stories and social media activities in cooperation with the Chief Communications Officer.

Development Research and Prospecting

  • Conduct research into new prospective funders as described above, from sectors we have not yet reached, that match IDC’s strategy and priorities, while respecting IDC’s ethical guidelines and policies.
  • Oversee and maintain a comprehensive funder database and assess prospective opportunities against IDC’s strategic priorities, programmes, and organisational capacity in consultation with relevant personnel.
  • Update IDC’s Executive Director, Programmes Manager and relevant personnel regularly by preparing concise prospect profiles and recommendations for internal consideration.
  • Develop and maintain a pipeline of prospective funding opportunities.

Funding Cultivation

  • Coordinate and contribute to the development of high-quality concept notes, proposals, pitch decks, and tailored partnership propositions for different types of prospective supporters, in collaboration with IDC’s Executive Director and relevant personnel.
  • Work with IDC colleagues, including the Chief Communications Officer to translate IDC’s mission, strategic priorities, programmes and approach into compelling and impact-oriented funding propositions, incorporating outcomes from impact monitoring and assessment, such as impact stories that resonate with funders’ interests and priorities.
  • Coordinate proposal development processes related to the mobilisation of private capital, including timelines, inputs, review and submission.
  • Maintain a forward-looking calendar of funding opportunities, applications, pitches and renewals.

Development Systems and MEL

  • Maintain and improve systems for tracking prospects, opportunities, applications, funder relationships and development activity.
  • Contribute to regular development reporting and pipeline reviews.
  • Track fundraising progress against agreed objectives and priorities.
  • Capture and share learning from successful and unsuccessful funding approaches.
  • Contribute to improving organisational fundraising tools, templates, processes and resources.

Collaboration and Teamwork

  • Work with relevant team members to develop and maintain a system for grant administration and acquisition, including development of resources and capacity building for IDC team members.
  • Work collaboratively with relevant team members, including the Executive Director, Programmes Manager, Chief Communications Officer, as well as the finance and regional programme teams to achieve fundraising goals and objectives.
  • Participate in team meetings, training sessions and other organisational activities as needed.

Core Responsibilities

  • Actively contribute to a culture of agile learning, collaboration, teamwork and support within the IDC team.
  • Demonstrate passion and alignment with IDC’s mission, vision and core values of innovation, collaboration, respect, inclusion, representation and being solutions-focused.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of IDC policies to ensure a positive and safe working environment for all.
  • Actively engage with organisational systems, processes and infrastructure to ensure sustainability and appropriate safeguarding of institutional knowledge, assets and core activities over time.
  • Test and use AI tools across relevant areas of work, where appropriate, to enhance efficiency, effectiveness and innovation.

Essential Qualifications

  • Relevant degree in management, business administration, economics, social sciences, communications, marketing or related field or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proven experience and a successful track record in fundraising or development and mobilisation of private capital for the non-profit sector.
  • Strategic and entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to recognise opportunities, think creatively, work proactively and develop new approaches to building partnerships and diversifying income.
  • Experience maintaining funding pipelines, donor information or similar relationship-management systems.
  • Knowledge of fundraising best practices and grant regulations
  • Ability to understand complex organisational or programme information and translate it into clear, compelling pitches.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the issues faced by refugees, people seeking asylum and migrants, particularly those affected by immigration detention.
  • Strong research, analytical and writing skills in English.
  • Excellent networking and relationship-building skills.
  • Excellent organisational skills including attention to detail, with the ability to multitask and prioritise effectively and work within time constraints and competing deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and proactively in a remote and internationally distributed team.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, donor management software, online research tools and relevant AI technologies.
  • Commitment to the mission and values of IDC.
  • Ability to travel if needed.

Desireable

  • Experience engaging with private philanthropists, corporate giving, family foundations, family offices, major donors, donor-advised funds (DAFs), philanthropic advisers or other private funding networks.
  • Familiarity with entrepreneurial networks, business angels or other intermediaries who can facilitate access to philanthropic capital.
  • Experience exploring alternative funding channels, such as digital giving, crypto philanthropy or other emerging approaches to resource mobilisation.
  • An established professional network in philanthropy, private giving, business development or related fields, or the ability to build such networks proactively.
  • Understanding of impact-oriented philanthropy and the ability to communicate the social impact of an organisation in ways that resonate with prospective supporters.
  • Knowledge of the Spanish language.
  • Knowledge of project management/fundraising software such as Salesforce, Sales Navigator, etc.

Application Process

To apply for this role, please upload your resume and a cover letter on IDC Careers’ Webpage, by Friday 6 November 2026. Please ensure that you clearly address all of the key selection criteria in your application.

If you have enquiries, please write to . Please note that applications will not be accepted if sent by email.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. The selected candidate will be expected to start as soon as possible.

NB: All applications must be submitted in English.

We envision a world where immigration detention no longer exists. And we work with everyone to make that vision a reality. We believe people should be able to live freely while they await the outcome of their immigration case, and we advocate for the human rights and dignity of everyone impacted by immigration detention.

IDC is solutions-focused, meaning that we work with lived experience leaders, governments, decision-makers, civil society, UN agencies and other actors to deliver alternatives that benefit migrants, communities and society at large. We are truly global, uniting a coalition of civil society organisations, community groups and individuals from all over the world. While the movement spans continents, we all have a clear purpose: to reduce and ultimately end immigration detention and to promote alternatives.

IDC values diversity, equality and inclusivity. Applications are welcome from all backgrounds. We especially encourage applications of those from underrepresented backgrounds, including but not limited to gender, race, age, sexual orientation, disability and religion. In particular, we highly encourage leaders with lived experience of the impacts of detention to apply. If potential candidates require any adaptations to usual recruitment processes, please do not hesitate to note this in your application.

Salary: €36,000 to €42,400 gross annually for 0.8 FTE (based on a full-time equivalent of €45,000 to €53,000)

We are seeking a highly experienced and results-oriented Senior Director of Sales to lead our client’s global sales strategy within the Money Transfer Operator (MTO) and Payment Service Provider (PSP) sectors. This critical leadership role will be responsible for driving significant revenue growth, managing their global sales team, and expanding their footprint into key international markets. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of the MTO/PSP landscape, a proven track record of exceeding sales targets, and an extensive network within major banks, MTOs, and payment service providers.

Workplace: Remote

  • Extensive and verifiable network of relationships with key decision-makers and influencers within the MTO and PSP industries.

  • Revenue Management: Own the global MTO/PSP revenue pipeline, forecasting, and P&L. Implement effective pricing strategies and negotiate high-value contracts to maximize profitability.

About the Role

Outsource Ability is recruiting on behalf of a UK software company that supplies freight management, transport management, demurrage and detention, and carbon emissions software to the logistics industry. The client is looking for an experienced B2B Appointment Setter to generate qualified product demonstrations with freight forwarders and logistics companies.

You will work through an existing database of around 3,000 contacts by telephone. You will find the right decision-makers, learn what software they use now, uncover their operational challenges and book qualified demonstrations. The focus is on real sales opportunities, not meetings booked to hit an activity target.

This is a telephone-based role. You will not send unsolicited sales emails, and you will not handle technical queries, pricing, commercial negotiations or contract discussions. These are referred to the client's business owner.

Outbound Calling & Appointment Setting

  • Work systematically through the existing database of around 3,000 contacts.

  • Identify and engage business owners, managing directors, operations directors and other relevant decision-makers.
  • Introduce the client's software and establish whether it could benefit the prospect's business.
  • Identify operational challenges, inefficiencies and frustrations with prospects' existing systems.
  • Qualify interest and book demonstrations with suitable prospects against an agreed qualification standard.
  • Match each prospect to the relevant product, using the product information and guidance provided.
  • Manage callbacks and follow-up calls where prospects are not immediately available.
  • Confirm booked demonstrations to reduce cancellations and no-shows.

Lead Qualification & Market Intelligence

  • Establish each prospect's current transport management or freight software and provider.
  • Record user numbers, current software costs and satisfaction levels where prospects are willing to share them.
  • Identify whether the prospect is considering a change of system, the reasons for it and the expected timescale.
  • Identify the decision-makers involved in purchasing.
  • Build market intelligence on competitor systems, pricing and customer requirements.

CRM & Database Management

  • Log every call attempt, outcome and conversation note in Zoho CRM.
  • Verify and update contact names, job titles, telephone numbers and LinkedIn profiles.
  • Apply the existing lead statuses and tags, and schedule callbacks and follow-up tasks.
  • Record demonstration bookings, outcomes and pipeline information accurately.
  • Clean the database alongside outbound calling, without letting it take priority over appointment generation.

Post-Demonstration Follow-Up

  • Contact prospects within one working day of a demonstration delivered by the client.
  • Establish feedback, level of interest, remaining questions and objections.
  • Confirm next steps and purchasing timescales, and follow up on outstanding decisions.
  • Arrange further discussions where required, without duplicating the work of the client's internal sales team.

Reporting & Compliance

  • Provide a weekly performance report that separates activity levels from commercial outcomes, including objections heard and competitor information gathered.
  • Screen calls against TPS/CTPS and follow UK telephone marketing and data protection rules.
  • Send emails only for appointment confirmations or when a prospect asks for information.
  • Take part in regular performance reviews and suggest improvements to messaging and qualification.

Systems

  • Zoho CRM
  • LinkedIn
  • Email and calendar tools
    Experience with every system is not essential, but you must be confident learning new technology.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Proven experience in B2B outbound appointment setting.
  • Confident speaking with business owners and senior decision-makers.
  • Strong telephone communication and objection-handling skills.
  • Experience identifying pain points and qualifying opportunities.
  • Experience working with a CRM system.
  • Excellent organisation and accurate record-keeping.
  • A proactive, professional and commercially focused approach.
  • A track record of consistently achieving appointment targets.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.

Advantageous

  • Experience in SaaS or business software sales.
  • Experience in freight forwarding, logistics or transport management systems.
  • Experience using Zoho CRM.
  • Experience calling UK businesses.

Key Performance Indicators
You will be measured on qualified demonstrations that actually take place. The target is a minimum of three each week once an agreed onboarding period ends. Only demonstrations with a relevant decision-maker who has a genuine requirement count towards it. You will also be expected to log every call in Zoho CRM, follow up within one working day after each demonstration and work through the full database systematically.

Working Arrangements

  • An initial onboarding period will allow you to learn the products, CRM processes and target market.
  • You will report weekly on activity and outcomes and take part in regular performance reviews.
  • Technical, pricing, commercial and contractual matters are referred to the client's business owner.

Remote Work Requirements

Applicants must:

  • Be based in South Africa.
  • Have a modern laptop or PC with an Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 processor or equivalent and a minimum of 8GB RAM.
  • Have a stable fibre connection with a minimum of 50 Mbps download and 50 Mbps upload.
  • Have a functional UPS, inverter or power station that can run the router and laptop for at least 2–4 hours during load shedding.

Job Title: In-Home Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant Part Time - Columbus

Job Location: Work at Home, Ohio, United States

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Part-time employees qualify for:

  • Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (NPs and PAs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Board certification (required)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

29.5

Part time

The typical pay range for this role is:

$41.85 - $90.13

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

raw.description:
About the Collaboration

OIKONOMAKIS LAW is a cross-border legal practice acting for private and corporate clients in international matters. We originate and retain the client relationship on the matters we place with national counsel, remain substantively involved in legal strategy and legal production, and use locally authorised lawyers for the host-law, reserved, procedural and court-facing work that requires national qualification or local rights.

Our objective is to build a small, non-exclusive panel of national counsel who already work in this manner with foreign law firms. We are not looking for a nominal signature or a referral-only relationship. Each paid matter is separately conflicted, scoped, priced and accepted before work begins.

Firm website:

The Firm’s Managing Partner, Christos Oikonomakis, is a Greek-qualified lawyer and is registered in Israel as a foreign lawyer.

Within the applicable Israeli regulatory framework governing foreign lawyers, Mr. Oikonomakis provides legal services in Israel concerning Greek law, within the scope permitted by his professional qualification and foreign-lawyer registration.

His status as a registered foreign lawyer does not authorize him to practice Israeli law.

OIKONOMAKIS LAW is therefore seeking to establish an independent professional collaboration with an experienced Israeli lawyer based in Tel Aviv or the wider Tel Aviv District who can independently undertake the Israeli-law components of cross-border matters handled by Mr. Oikonomakis and the Firm.

Nature of the Opportunity

This is not an employment position.

We are inviting proposals for an independent professional collaboration between OIKONOMAKIS LAW / Christos Oikonomakis and an Israeli legal practitioner or independent Israeli legal practice.

The participating lawyers and legal practices will remain fully:

* professionally independent;

  • legally and scientifically independent;

* financially independent;

* organizationally independent; and

* corporately independent.

Each lawyer or legal practice will remain independently responsible for:

  • the legal advice and services provided by them;
  • compliance with the professional and regulatory framework applicable to their own practice;

* professional conduct requirements;

  • professional liability and insurance arrangements applicable to them;
  • their own professional decisions and legal opinions; and
  • the conduct of those parts of each matter falling within their respective professional qualification and authorization.

The collaboration may operate on a case-by-case, referral, co-counsel and/or continuing professional collaboration basis depending upon the nature and volume of cross-border matters.

Scope of Collaboration

Cross-border matters may involve circumstances where Mr Oikonomakis provides advice concerning Greek law while the same transaction, dispute or client matter simultaneously raises issues of Israeli law.

In such circumstances, the selected Israeli lawyer may be independently instructed to undertake the relevant Israeli-law workstream.

This may include, where appropriate:

* advising on Israeli law;

* preparing Israeli legal opinions;

  • identifying Israeli-law implications arising from cross-border matters;
  • drafting and reviewing contracts governed by Israeli law;

* corporate and commercial matters;

* company and investment matters;

* civil and commercial disputes;

* litigation and dispute resolution;

  • recognition and enforcement of foreign judgments;
  • arbitration and alternative dispute resolution;

* property and real estate matters;

* immigration and residency matters;

* inheritance and succession matters;

  • family and private client matters involving Greece and Israel;

* banking and regulatory matters;

  • dealings with Israeli public authorities, registries and institutions;
  • representation before Israeli courts, tribunals or authorities where professionally appropriate;
  • negotiations with Israeli counterparties;

* conducting Israeli legal research;

  • preparing Israeli-law memoranda and procedural documentation; and
  • cooperating with Greek and other international counsel on multi-jurisdictional matters.

The objective is to provide clients with coordinated and efficient cross-border assistance while ensuring a clear division between Greek-law legal services and Israeli-law legal services.

Regulatory Structure

The proposed cooperation is designed specifically to respect the professional boundaries applicable to foreign lawyers operating in Israel.

Mr. Christos Oikonomakis will provide legal services only within the scope of his foreign professional qualification and registration in Israel, including advice and legal work concerning Greek law.

Any legal service that constitutes the practice of Israeli law will be undertaken independently by the appropriately qualified Israeli lawyer.

The Israeli collaborating lawyer will retain complete professional control and responsibility for the Israeli-law component of any matter entrusted to them.

Requirements

Applicants must:

  • be fully admitted to practice law in Israel;
  • be current members of the Israel Bar Association;
  • be legally authorized to practice Israeli law;

* be in good professional standing;

  • have a minimum of five (5) years of post-qualification legal experience;
  • maintain the professional arrangements and insurance appropriate to their practice;
  • be based in Tel Aviv or otherwise able to provide effective legal services throughout Israel;
  • possess excellent legal drafting, research and analytical skills;
  • demonstrate the ability to handle matters independently;
  • have strong professional judgment and client-management abilities;
  • have excellent written and spoken Hebrew;
  • have excellent written and spoken English; and
  • maintain high standards of confidentiality, professional ethics and responsiveness.

Preferred Experience

Particular consideration will be given to lawyers experienced in one or more of the following areas:

* Corporate and Commercial Law

* Commercial Litigation

* Civil Litigation

* Contract Law

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care. In this role, you’ll be primarily traveling - up to 100% of the time - across a defined coverage area, as defined by business needs. This may require overnight hotel stays, car rentals and/or flights, depending on the prescribed coverage area. Holding multiple state licenses will be required, as dictated by business needs.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Who is PackIOT?

The world is full of smart people, successful companies,great products, so why did we have to create a new one? It is nomystery that we are experiencing a new digital revolution, and themanufacturing industry is lagging behind.

That is why developing a new product really enables thetransformations of Industry 4.0 and the Internet of Things (IoT) toarrive in places that have not yet been reached, facilitating not only the workindustries’ owners, but of everyone who works there.

And that’s what we want to be: an agent of change throughour work of excellence. With our plug-and-play production analyticssoftware, we help industrial manufacturers to be more efficient, reducing theircosts and eliminating the paperwork that keeps workers from being their bestversions.

Today we are in full expansion! We have customers inmore than 6 countries, such as Switzerland, United States, Canada, Portugal,Hungary and Brazil, with projects on 4 continents, always seeking to growmore and more.

And this international mindset is not limited to our worldwide reach of customers: our colleagues are also in different countries,since we have two offices, one in Florianópolis (Brazil) and another inLisbon (Portugal).

Also, we have professionals working from other countries orfrom different nationalities, such as Germany, Honduras, and Italy!

From this remote culture, we are looking for people willingto learn and develop constantly; who wish to take risks in new challenges and bepart of our team building! Therefore, we are proud to share the values ​​thatmake us unique:

  • We believe in transparent and respectful relationships,working with a flat hierarchy;
  • We have a constant feedback culture to grow together;
  • We are always learning and sharing our knowledge,that's why we focus and invest in your development;
  • We live guided by ownership, encouraging our colleagues toown their projects;
  • We understand that our work environment is the bestplace to take risks and constantly innovate;
  • We aim at customer-centered work, with ethics and respect toimprove their reality.

So, what do you think about taking on this new challenge?Check out more details of the Senior Full Stack Analyst job below!

Impact and Responsibilities

We know: the work of developing and monitoring a program canbe challenging (but what's better than a good challenge for ourdevelopment?!). Therefore, we share your main impacts and responsibilities onthe team:

  • Work with back-end tecnologies, supporting APIswritten in Javascript and Python, as well as dealing with SQL and NoSQLDatabases, edge computing and insutrial gateways;
  • Improve and refactor our Python API andmicroservices in Python and Javascript;
  • On the front-end, you'll work with React Web Apps, aswell as integration with Business Inteligence tools and chartlibraries, creating great dashboards for our customers;
  • You'll work with Edge computing, connecting sensors toEdge devices that send IoT data to the cloud;
  • You'll work with SQL, NoSQL and Time-Series Databases, usingtech that are on the state-of-the-art in Industrial Internet of Things andSoftware;
  • You'll be responsible for reviewing the work andassisting the guidance of junior professionals.

Attitudes and Knowledge

For that, we understand that you also need to know what arethe necessary and desirable attitudes and knowledge to make yourimpact with excellence, right? Check out what we’re looking for below:

Why work with us?

After all, why do we want you to come to work with us andwhat do we guarantee as a differential and benefits for thedevelopment of your career? We decided to detail this below:

  • We want to increasingly expand our reach, working withpeople all over the world. Then, you will have the opportunity tolearn more about different cultures, in addition to strengthening your networkwith professionals of excellence working alongside you;

We are looking for a Senior Director, Business Design to join our team. At Runyon, Business Designers drive the analysis of the viability of products and ventures, and articulate how optimal business models shape the experience, and vice versa. They consider a series of monetization opportunities, operational considerations as well as the growth implications to scale into market while maintaining a firm understanding of the underlying market dynamics of incumbent position, emergent players and value exchange across key stakeholders in the ecosystem.

This role requires someone who is highly strategic, detail-oriented, and experienced in financial modeling, performing competitive analyses, creating growth strategies and testing value hypotheses and growth hypotheses from low to increasing live fidelity. They have the ability to develop a deep understanding of a partner’s business and translate those into a plan of action. They develop strong relationships and build trust with core decision-makers, both internally and externally.

About Runyon

Runyon is a product design and venture studio that helps companies grow. We are a team of customer-centered designers, researchers, and strategists that crafts new products, experiences and ventures. Our approach combines customer needs and behaviors with leading edge business strategy. Our work is sprint- and prototype-driven and we think about how we can craft strategies and products into the market in ways that are meaningful and measured from the start. Our team has decades of experience working with some of the largest global partners including Disney, The New York Times, American Express, Target and others.

  • We're prototyping-led. We lead with tangible assumptions in the form of prototypes and test them with real stakeholders to validate and refine our strategy and design. Regardless of discipline, we think and communicate in concepts, and use those to move further, faster.
  • We're detailed and intentional. We always back up our design decisions with sound reasoning—be it user research, market research, or both. We make things that make sense and that have a clear through line.
  • We're fast. We work almost exclusively in sprints, and with lean teams. We need folks who like to run.
  • We're collaborative. We jam as a multidisciplinary team of specialists who collectively contribute to the full spectrum of work across user research, strategy and design to arrive at high quality outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Actively participate in ideation sessions with cross-functional teams to conceptualize new experiences, products, services, and ventures that create differentiated market opportunities
  • Collaborate with internal teams and senior client partners to define strategic success criteria, business objectives, and opportunities for growth
  • Design profitable new products, brands, services, business models, and ventures, translating strategic opportunities into tangible, market-ready solutions
  • Shape growth and go-to-market strategies for new products and ventures, aligning business, financial, and operational objectives
  • Craft design-driven market and competitive analyses that uncover opportunities, inform strategic direction, and position our partners for differentiation
  • Develop financial models that establish what needs to be true for revenue growth, product and venture success, and long-term business sustainability
  • Shape operational plans, resource strategies, and strategic partnerships that support product development, venture incubation, and business growth
  • Develop and lead experiments that generate actionable insights, validate opportunities, and inform strategic product and venture roadmaps
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities, and identify opportunities to integrate them into meaningful product, service, and venture solutions
  • Establish deep partnerships with cross-functional teams and client stakeholders, ensuring alignment and collaborative progress toward key strategic and product milestones

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of experience as a business designer, business strategist, or business analyst at a design studio, consultancy, or internally within an organization
  • Fluent in business acumen, including knowledge in strategy, marketing, finance, operations and product development
  • Ability to build and interpret financial models to quantify business impact
  • Ability to interpret and communicate complex business ideas to different audiences, in addition to listening and modifying your thinking based on the contributions and perspectives of others
  • Ability to easily adapt, and switch between different projects, businesses and industries
  • A desire to engage with collaborative, multi-disciplinary teams which include our partners
  • A proven track record of successfully launched products as a business designer, product manager, product growth strategist, and/or as a startup founder
  • Great communication and time management abilities, including the skill to direct and manage small teams and judiciously involve investors, experts, and stakeholders
  • You thrive in ambiguity, and have a propensity to experiment with generative ideas in order to identify the most innovative and disruptive solutions

Please note that this job posting remains active as part of our ongoing effort to build a network of talented designers, strategists, researchers, and other creative professionals. As a result, it may not correspond to an immediate opening. Runyon’s dynamic, fast-paced environment makes this ideal for candidates who thrive in flexible, project-based roles.

Salary: $750 - $1,300 / day based on experience and skill level

raw.title: Test Analyst – Remote-First
raw.excerpt: 🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated.
raw.description:
🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays

In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated. Random delays, confusing rules, extra apps and accounts make it harder than it should be to pay and get paid.

The European Payments Initiative is changing that with Wero, a proudly European digital wallet to make payments easier, clearer and more secure. Online, in store, at home and across borders, with your money and data protected under European laws and regulations.

Wero is live in Belgium, France and Germany and launching very soon in Luxembourg and the Netherlands. Backed by 16 major banks and the two largest European acquirers, we’re building a brand new, proudly European payment system. Why not join us?

🔎 What's in it for you

Play a key role in onboarding and certifying banks, acquirers, and payment service providers across Europe onto the Wero network. Working at the crossroads of API testing, end-to-end certification, and partner engagement, you will collaborate closely with external stakeholders to ensure seamless integrations. This is a unique opportunity to join a remote-first, high-impact environment where you directly contribute to the quality, interoperability, and reliability of Europe's next-generation payments infrastructure.

🐝 About the team

You’ll join the Member Quality Assurance team within Operations Services Delivery. The team is responsible for coordinating, scoping and validating testing activities for EPI member institutions, helping banks, acquirers and PSPs successfully integrate with Wero.

You’ll work closely with external member banks, acquirers, PSPs and test tooling partners, as well as internal Product, Payment Experience, Infrastructure and Operations teams. This is a collaborative role for someone who enjoys combining structured testing, technical investigation and clear partner communication.

💥 Your impact

  • Scope testing requirements and guide member banks, acquirers and PSPs through end-to-end certification with clear instructions and hands-on technical support.

  • Review and validate member test outcomes against EPI specifications, scheme standards and compliance rules to ensure seamless integration.

  • Investigate technical issues during testing, analyse distributed system logs and inspect API payloads to identify and resolve blockers quickly.

  • Execute internal tests to identify edge cases, inconsistencies and system gaps before member releases.

  • Convert manual test scenarios into automated test cases and contribute to the continuous improvement of testing frameworks and tooling.

  • Maintain comprehensive records of test results, defects, decisions and resolutions in Jira and Confluence for full traceability and auditability.

  • Collaborate with Product, Payment Experience, Infrastructure and Operations stakeholders to ensure testing feedback is understood and translated into product and process improvements.

💻 Technology stack & way of working

  • Testing & API tools: REST APIs, JSON, Postman, Bruno, API scripting and automation, Fime test tools

  • Tracking & collaboration: Jira, Confluence

  • Ways of working: Agile methodology, daily stand-ups, cross-functional collaboration and close interaction with external partners

🕵🏻‍♀️ To succeed, you should meet at least 70% of these requirements

  • +3 years of professional experience in QA, testing, technical operations or a similar role, ideally within payments, banking or fintech.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field is preferred, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Fluent in English (CEFR C1 or C2); French, German, Dutch or other European languages are a plus.

  • Thrive in a remote-first, multicultural and fast-paced environment.

  • Strong experience in end-to-end and integration testing across multi-tier or distributed architectures.

  • Hands-on proficiency with REST APIs, JSON data contracts and API testing or scripting tools such as Postman or Bruno.

  • Solid experience reading system logs, debugging integration errors and troubleshooting issues across distributed services.

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with external partners, member institutions, clients or technical stakeholders such as Project Leads and Test Managers.

  • Proficiency with test management workflows, issue tracking and documentation using tools such as Jira and Confluence.

  • Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear guidance for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to haves

  • Familiarity with European payment schemes and rails such as SEPA, Instant Payments, SWIFT or card schemes.

  • Experience with payment gateways, processors, core banking platforms or mobile banking integrations.

  • Understanding of regulatory and scheme certification standards such as PSD2 or scheme compliance.

  • Knowledge of reconciliation, clearing and settlement workflows.

🪜 If this looks like you, the recruitment steps are:

  1. A first call with one of our recruiters

  2. A culture interview with the hiring manager

  3. A technical interview with Test Engineer

  4. Hopefully, an offer you can’t refuse

⛔ Turn back if …

  • You prefer working in a purely internal or isolated testing environment without direct external partner or bank interaction.

  • You shy away from digging into logs, investigating API discrepancies or multitasking across several onboarding and certification tracks.

  • You are looking for a rigid, fully static environment rather than an evolving, agile pan-European initiative.

🎁 What we can offer

  • Remote-first culture with quarterly and annual all-staff in-person meetups to keep teams connected and collaborative

  • Possibility to work from another EU country for up to 3 months per year

  • Competitive compensation package, featuring salary, performance-based bonus and a thoughtfully designed, high-quality benefits programme

  • The opportunity to be part of a true pan-European company

  • Learning & development budget: €5,000 training budget per year

Otherwise apply!

🫶 Our commitment to equal employment opportunities

EPI offers the same job opportunities to all, without distinction of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability or age. EPI promotes the development of an inclusive work environment that mirrors the diversity of the clients our product is serving.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on sales leader who understands how to build a high-performing team, identify performance gaps, coach salespeople effectively, and create an environment where sales professionals can consistently improve and achieve their targets.

  • Australian Morning Shift / Dayshift

Sales Leadership & Performance

  • Lead and manage the day-to-day performance of the sales team.
  • Set clear expectations and ensure team members consistently work toward assigned sales targets and KPIs.
  • Monitor individual and team sales performance and identify areas requiring improvement.
  • Develop strategies and action plans to improve conversion, productivity, revenue, and overall team performance.
  • Maintain accountability while creating a positive and motivated sales environment.
  • Lead by example and demonstrate strong sales discipline and commercial awareness.

Coaching & Team Development

  • Coach, mentor, and develop sales representatives to help them reach their full potential.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, one-on-one coaching sessions, and team meetings.
  • Identify individual strengths, weaknesses, and development opportunities.
  • Provide practical coaching around sales conversations, objection handling, closing, follow-ups, and customer engagement.
  • Help new salespeople ramp up quickly and become productive members of the team.
  • Build a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and high performance.

Recruitment & Onboarding

  • Participate in the recruitment and selection of new sales team members.
  • Help identify candidates with the right sales ability, attitude, work ethic, and cultural fit.
  • Support onboarding and initial training of new sales hires.
  • Ensure new team members understand sales processes, expectations, KPIs, and performance standards.

Sales Operations & Reporting

  • Monitor CRM activity, sales pipelines, conversion rates, and other key performance indicators.
  • Analyse sales data to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare and communicate regular sales performance reports.
  • Ensure accurate and timely CRM updates and sales documentation.
  • Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to increase efficiency and sales performance.
  • Work closely with senior leadership on forecasting, target setting, and sales planning.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Build strong relationships with team members and maintain open communication.
  • Motivate the team during periods of high pressure or challenging sales performance.
  • Address performance issues promptly and fairly.
  • Recognise and reinforce strong performance.
  • Promote professionalism, integrity, accountability, and a results-oriented culture.
  • Handle sensitive customer and business information with a high level of confidentiality and integrity.

Qualifications

MUST HAVE

  • At least 5 years of sales experience, preferably in an international/B2B/B2C sales environment.
  • At least 3–5 years of experience as a Sales Team Leader, Sales Manager, or similar sales leadership position.
  • Proven experience leading and developing a sales team.
  • Demonstrated ability to consistently achieve or exceed sales targets and KPIs.
  • Strong experience in coaching, mentoring, and performance management.
  • Strong understanding of sales processes, conversion, objection handling, and closing.
  • Experience recruiting, onboarding, and developing salespeople is highly preferred.
  • Experience working with CRM systems and sales reporting tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Highly organised, proactive, and able to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong sense of accountability, integrity, and professionalism.

PREFERRED

  • BPO or outsourcing industry experience.
  • Experience handling international markets, particularly Australia.
  • B2B sales experience.
  • Experience selling high-ticket products, services, education, training, or professional services.
  • Experience managing remote sales teams.
  • Proven history of sales awards, recognition, or measurable team achievements.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who can prove they have successfully led salespeople before.

You should be comfortable looking at a sales dashboard and immediately identifying where the problem is — whether it is lead quality, activity levels, conversion, follow-up, objection handling, closing ability, or individual salesperson performance.

Most importantly, you should know how to turn underperforming salespeople into productive salespeople and high-performing teams into even stronger teams.

If you are a hands-on sales leader who enjoys coaching people, solving sales problems, driving numbers, and building winning teams, we want to hear from you.

Please do not apply if you do not have proven experience leading a sales team.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on sales leader who understands how to build a high-performing team, identify performance gaps, coach salespeople effectively, and create an environment where sales professionals can consistently improve and achieve their targets.

Coaching & Team Development

  • Identify individual strengths, weaknesses, and development opportunities.
  • Provide practical coaching around sales conversations, objection handling, closing, follow-ups, and customer engagement.
  • Help new salespeople ramp up quickly and become productive members of the team.
  • Build a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and high performance.

Recruitment & Onboarding

  • Participate in the recruitment and selection of new sales team members.
  • Help identify candidates with the right sales ability, attitude, work ethic, and cultural fit.
  • Support onboarding and initial training of new sales hires.
  • Ensure new team members understand sales processes, expectations, KPIs, and performance standards.

Sales Operations & Reporting

  • Monitor CRM activity, sales pipelines, conversion rates, and other key performance indicators.
  • Analyse sales data to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare and communicate regular sales performance reports.
  • Ensure accurate and timely CRM updates and sales documentation.
  • Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to increase efficiency and sales performance.
  • Work closely with senior leadership on forecasting, target setting, and sales planning.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Build strong relationships with team members and maintain open communication.
  • Motivate the team during periods of high pressure or challenging sales performance.
  • Address performance issues promptly and fairly.
  • Recognise and reinforce strong performance.
  • Promote professionalism, integrity, accountability, and a results-oriented culture.
  • Handle sensitive customer and business information with a high level of confidentiality and integrity.

Qualifications

MUST HAVE

  • At least 5 years of sales experience, preferably in an international/B2B/B2C sales environment.
  • At least 3–5 years of experience as a Sales Team Leader, Sales Manager, or similar sales leadership position.

  • Demonstrated ability to consistently achieve or exceed sales targets and KPIs.
  • Strong experience in coaching, mentoring, and performance management.
  • Strong understanding of sales processes, conversion, objection handling, and closing.
  • Experience recruiting, onboarding, and developing salespeople is highly preferred.
  • Experience working with CRM systems and sales reporting tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Highly organised, proactive, and able to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong sense of accountability, integrity, and professionalism.

PREFERRED

  • BPO or outsourcing industry experience.
  • Experience handling international markets, particularly Australia.
  • B2B sales experience.
  • Experience selling high-ticket products, services, education, training, or professional services.
  • Experience managing remote sales teams.
  • Proven history of sales awards, recognition, or measurable team achievements.

We are looking for someone who can prove they have successfully led salespeople before.

Most importantly, you should know how to turn underperforming salespeople into productive salespeople and high-performing teams into even stronger teams.

If you are a hands-on sales leader who enjoys coaching people, solving sales problems, driving numbers, and building winning teams, we want to hear from you.

Job Summary:

The Accountant is responsible for supporting the day-to-day accounting operations of the company by maintaining accurate financial records, ensuring transactions are properly recorded, and assisting with reconciliations and financial reporting.

The role covers a broad range of accounting activities, including transaction recording, inventory accounting, sales reconciliation, payroll review, VAT compliance, and financial documentation, while ensuring adherence to company policies, accounting standards, and International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:

Accounting Records

  • Record daily financial transactions in the accounting system.
  • Prepare and post journal entries with proper supporting documentation.
  • Maintain accurate and organized financial records.

Accounts Processing

  • Record supplier invoices and assist with supplier payment processing in coordination with the Finance Manager.
  • Record customer payments and monitor receivable balances.
  • Ensure expenses are recorded accurately and allocated to the appropriate accounts.

Store & POS Reconciliation

  • Reconcile store sales with POS reports and system records.
  • Review store cash deposits and investigate discrepancies.
  • Ensure accurate recording of sales from all channels, including retail stores and online platforms.

Inventory Accounting

  • Record inventory transactions and adjustments in the accounting system.
  • Assist in reconciling physical inventory with system records.
  • Support stock count procedures and investigate inventory variances.
  • Calculate and allocate landed costs (freight, customs duties, and related import expenses) to inventory to ensure accurate product costing.

Bank & Account Reconciliation

  • Perform regular bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies.
  • Reconcile supplier, customer, and other balance sheet accounts.
  • Review account balances to ensure accuracy and completeness.

Financial Closing

  • Assist with monthly financial closing activities.
  • Ensure transactions are recorded in the correct accounting period.
  • Support preparation of financial schedules and reports in accordance with IFRS principles and company accounting policies.

Payroll & Employee Earnings Review

  • Review employee payroll records, including salaries, allowances, overtime, and other earnings before processing.
  • Ensure payroll calculations are accurate and supported by approved documentation.
  • Verify that payroll entries are correctly recorded in the accounting system and allocated to the appropriate accounts.

VAT Compliance

  • Ensure transactions are properly recorded for VAT purposes.
  • Maintain VAT documentation and supporting records.
  • Assist in preparing VAT reports in compliance with ZATCA regulations.

Expense Review & Control

  • Review expense claims and supporting documents for completeness and compliance with company policies.
  • Ensure expenses are properly authorized before recording them.

Operational Coordination

  • Coordinate with operations, warehouse, and store teams regarding financial matters.
  • Support improvements in accounting procedures and internal controls.
  • Perform other accounting-related duties assigned by the Finance Manager.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • Minimum 5 years of accounting experience.
  • Experience using Odoo ERP or similar accounting systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Good command of English (spoken and written).
  • Good understanding of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and accounting principles.

Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

Job Description – Administrador de Sistemas / Infraestrutura

Sobre a área

A área de Global Tech – Services and Operations é responsável pela sustentação e administração dos serviços centrais de infraestrutura tecnológica da Arcadis, atuando globalmente na gestão de servidores, redes, identidade e acesso, monitoramento, backup e recuperação.

Atuação: Global

Descrição da função

Atuar na administração, sustentação e evolução da infraestrutura tecnológica, garantindo disponibilidade, segurança e continuidade dos serviços. Será responsável por ambientes Windows e Linux, serviços de identidade e acesso, backup e disaster recovery, monitoramento, ativos de TI e plataformas em Azure, atuando também na resolução de incidentes e implantação de melhorias.

Responsabilidades da função

  • Administrar ambientes de infraestrutura, incluindo backups, restores e Disaster Recovery, garantindo a recuperação e continuidade dos serviços.

  • Administrar Microsoft Active Directory, Identity & Access Management, SSO, autenticação e federação de identidade.
  • Executar patches, upgrades, implantação e manutenção de sistemas operacionais, servidores e plataformas de infraestrutura.
  • Gerenciar ativos de infraestrutura e CMDB, apoiando mudanças e práticas de IT Asset Management.
  • Atuar na administração e melhoria de ambientes Windows Server, Linux, Azure, virtualização e redes corporativas.

Qualificações e experiência

  • Experiência em administração de infraestrutura com Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory e DNS.

  • Experiência com Microsoft Azure, incluindo IaaS, PaaS e Azure Storage.

  • Experiência com Identity & Access Management, SSO e federação de identidade.

É por isso que somos pioneiros em uma abordagem baseada em habilidades, onde você pode aproveitar suas experiências e conhecimento único para traçar seu caminho profissional e maximizar o impacto que podemos gerar juntos.

Você realizará um trabalho significativo e, não importa qual seja o cargo, ajudando a oferecer soluções sustentáveis para um planeta mais próspero. Faça sua marca, em sua carreira, colegas, clientes, vida e no mundo ao seu redor.

raw.companyName: The International Centre for Missing and Exploited Children
raw.description:
Thank you for your interest in interning at the International Centre for Missing & Exploited Children (ICMEC). Interns contribute substantially to the work of ICMEC, and ICMEC’s staff work closely with interns to make the experience as rewarding as possible.

The International Centre for Missing & Exploited Children (ICMEC) is a private, nonprofit organization established more than 25 years ago. ICMEC is headquartered in the United States, with formal representation in numerous countries around the globe. ICMEC works to make the world a safer place for children by defending against child sexual exploitation, abuse, and the risk of going missing. ICMEC works with partners around the world to develop research, technologies, and educational resources to aid in the search and recovery of children who are missing, fight child sexual exploitation and empower caring professionals, institutions, and communities to safeguard children from all forms of sexual abuse.

The Koons Family Institute on International Law & Policy (The Koons Family Institute) is ICMEC’s in-house research arm. The Koons Family Institute defends children against sexual exploitation, abuse, or risk of going missing on multiple fronts by conducting and commissioning original research into the status of child protection laws around the world, creating replicable legal tools, promoting best practices, bringing together great thinkers and opinion leaders, and collaborating with partners to identify and measure threats to children and ways ICMEC can advocate change.

Our Mission
ICMEC envisions a world where children can grow up safe from exploitation, abuse, or the risk of going missing. We believe every child deserves a safe childhood. ICMEC’s mission is to advance child protection and safeguard vulnerable children around the world.

We do this by:

  • building and improving systems to prevent and respond to cases of missing children, child sexual exploitation, or abuse;
  • advocating for enhanced laws and policies;
  • mobilizing industries to secure their technologies and platforms from becoming vehicles for abuse and exploitation;
  • providing tools and training for criminal justice professionals to effectively investigate and prosecute cases of exploitation, abuse or children who are missing;
  • safeguarding school environments; and
  • empowering healthcare professionals to recognize and respond to child abuse and exploitation cases.

As the workload of ICMEC continues to grow and resources are stretched, the contributions of interns are extremely important. ICMEC interns who share the same belief in our goals help to make the success stories happen. ICMEC offers full‐ and part‐time internships each academic semester. Successful applicants will be highly motivated, detail-oriented, independent students with a passion for public interest work.

*We are now accepting applications for the Fall 2025 intern class.

Internship positions:

The Legal Research Interns will support the Director of The Koons Family Institute by writing, editing, and conducting comprehensive research and analysis on global policies and laws for a variety of publications, reports, white papers, and other projects. Interns may focus on topics such as child sexual abuse material, online grooming, missing children, child sex trafficking, child sexual abuse and exploitation, sextortion, age verification for online platforms, and other related topics. Interns specific projects may include engaging with policy experts within the technology industry and contributing to important discussions surrounding digital safety for children; reviewing global laws and regulations related to age verification and analyzing age verification measures across various countries to identify trends, best practices, and gaps in policy; and summarizing findings into briefs and reports that highlight trends, key insights, and provide policy recommendations for enhancing age verification processes. Interns also may utilize foreign language skills and regional areas of expertise.

Specific requirements by internship position:

Legal Research Internsmust:

  • Be available to work 12 to 15 weeks, at least 15 hours per week (20+ hours preferred) during the Fall or Spring semesters; or
  • Be available to work 8 to 12 weeks, at least 20 hours per week (30+ hours preferred) during the Summer term;
  • Undergo initial and periodic background checks; and
  • Have completed undergraduate studies (working toward a Master’s or Juris Doctorate degree strongly preferred). We will consider students in their sophomore, junior, or senior year of undergraduate studies with relevant experience.

*Internships will be completed primarily remotely, with the possibility of limited in-person interaction in the ICMEC office in Alexandria, Virginia, if conditions allow.

Is the internship paid?

All internships are unpaid.

Is academic credit granted for the internship?

Internships may be granted academic credit (please refer to your school’s internship/externship requirements).

Does ICMEC provide housing?

ICMEC does not provide housing for interns nor do we provide a stipend to cover living expenses.

How do I apply?

An application form is available at . You can submit the application form online and please be sure to include a Statement of Purpose or cover letter, résumé/CV, official or unofficial transcripts, and a writing sample.

Point of Contact:

Internship Coordinator

International Centre for Missing & Exploited Children

2318 Mill Road, Suite 1010

Alexandria, VA 22314

Applications must be received by the application deadline (though deadlines may be extended as needed):

  • Fall Semester - August 23
  • Spring Semester - December 31
  • Summer semester - March 16

Your interest in ICMEC is very much appreciated, and we look forward to helping you have a rewarding and fulfilling experience.

What’s next?

You will hear from us as soon as your application has been reviewed, usually within three (3) weeks.

ICMEC is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, disability, or other legally protected basis. All decisions regarding employment issues are based on a person’s overall qualifications and their ability to meet the position requirements.
