Our client is a globally regulated Forex and CFD broker, founded in 2017 and regulated in UK (FCA), UAE (ESCA/DIFC), and Seychelles (FSA) licenses. The headquarters is in Dubai with international offices in 13 countries and 200 professional team across the regions.

The group is catering to both retail and institutional client's offering customised pricing and liquidity setups, in providing the world class trading services to its clients, with core values of Integrity, Collaboration, Curiosity, Tenacity, and Excellence.

About the role:

As a Market Analyst, you will play a key role in interpreting financial news and market trends, transforming them into engaging and educational content across various platforms. Your insights will help demystify complex market movements for our audience, empowering them to make informed decisions. Youll also contribute to content strategy by identifying new opportunities to inform and engage our community. If youre passionate about finance, skilled in content creation, and enjoy helping others navigate the markets, wed love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Produce daily, original content on financial market trends for social media, webinars, and our website (in both video and written formats).
  • Deliver live presentations via webinars and events to educate and engage audiences.
  • Conduct one-on-one client discussions to provide market insights and support.
  • Identify and propose new content formats and topics to enhance audience engagement.
  • Ensure all content is clear, accurate, and professionally presented.
  • Collaborate closely with the marketing team to align content with broader campaigns.
  • Work with internal teams to optimize content strategy and delivery.
  • Perform other duties as reasonably required to support the role and team objectives.

Experience and Qualifications:

  • Diploma or Bachelors Degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Prior experience in a similar role within the FX or financial services industry is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of financial markets and instruments.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in English (minimum B1 level)

Person Specification:

  • Strong analytical and organizational skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English and Spanish.
  • Confident, articulate, and able to build strong relationships internally and externally.
  • Self-motivated team player with a proactive and positive attitude.
  • Effective time management and ability to prioritize tasks

Job Title: In-Home Physician Per Diem - Leon

Job Location: Work at Home, Iowa, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Part time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Per diem employees qualify for:

  • Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours

12

Time Type

Part time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$105.00 - $105.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 12/31/2026

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

Company Description

At Shockingly Different Leadership, we are changing the way HR-functions scale up their teams during peak periods of work!

SDL is a global talent development and "people-project" support consultancy. We provide the best consulting expertise in the areas of Talent Development, Organizational Development, Change Management, and Human Resources, on an on-demand, project, or flexible basis.

We've hired the best proven experts across the globe, made our services competitively affordable, and added a high dose of empathy to "meet clients where they are", no matter how ambiguous or complicated their initiative. Our clients deserve a partner who co-creates with them to deliver great work that achieves "shockingly different" results!

Job Description

We are seeking talent with expertise as Virtual Workshop Producers, to join our growing contractor pool. The Virtual Workshop Producer will be responsible for supporting Facilitators as they present learning programs to SDLs clients. This position will work alongside other Facilitation, Technology and Account team members in order to present a seamless experience for participants.

You will be supporting a single vILT course for up to 25 attendees, Monday through Friday, during business hours. You will be responsible for making the online classroom experience seamless for participants to engage with tools like video sharing, whiteboarding, chat, polls and quizzes. This is a long-term, ongoing, remote contract position. You would be booked on an on-demand basis, averaging 2-5 workshops per month.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Support all 3-6 hour courses : pre-production, during workshop, and post-production.
  • Coordinate and upload all presentation materials, include slide deck, handouts, activities, etc.
  • Start the meeting when it is time
  • Be primary support for workshop facilitator; help the Facilitator manage time, field chat questions, introduce questions when timing is appropriate, and take notes for Facilitators to follow up with participants after class if time in class doesn't allow
  • Moderate online training sessions, tracking lessons learned to help create documentation on best practices
  • Provide feedback and reporting issues with the platform, as well as provide feedback on Facilitator and participant engagement to the Account team

Qualifications

Qualifications include:

  • Must have a college degree.
  • Deep knowledge of online tools such as WebEx, Zoom, Go-To-Meeting and Adobe Connect; Deep experience with WebEx a strong plus
  • 1-3 years experience in facilitating soft skills, management or leadership development workshops.
  • 1-2 years experience setting up/producing online events
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools
  • Ability to work in high-pressure situations and handle multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining a professional and appropriate demeanor
  • The ability to prioritize tasks and to carry out responsibilities with little or no supervision
  • Must have own computer, speaker/headset, broadband high speed internet connection, and webcam
  • Be comfortable on camera and have a presentable home office that doesn't distract participants from the vILT experience
  • Have familiarity with operating systems to help diagnose issues with connecting speakers, webcams and microphones
  • Understand how browser access is imperative to helping participants join the session and engage in the session by being able to see, hear and speak

Additional Information

COMPENSATION: This position is paid per hour. Only candidates who include their fee requirements will be considered.

APPLICATION PROCEDURE: If you've read this far, we think you're ready to try the first step. Still interested? If so, Apply now!

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Discover your 100% YOU with MicroSourcing!

﻿

Position: Accounts Payable Team Lead

Work setup & shift: Work from home

﻿

Why join MicroSourcing?

You'll have:

  • Competitive Rewards: Enjoy above-market compensation, healthcare coverage on day one, plus one or more dependents, paid time-off with cash conversion, group life insurance, and performance bonuses

  • A Collaborative Spirit: Contribute to a positive and engaging work environment by participating in company-sponsored events and activities.

  • Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy the balance between work and life that suits you with flexible work arrangements.

  • Career Growth: Take advantage of opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.

  • Inclusive Teamwork: Be part of a team that celebrates diversity and fosters an inclusive culture.

Your Role:

We are seeking an experienced and proactive Accounts Payable Supervisor to lead our AP operations. The ideal candidate must possess an advanced understanding of general accounting principles and expert-level proficiency in MS Excel. You will be responsible for leading a team, driving process improvements, and ensuring that strict weekly, monthly, and quarterly deadlines are met with precision. Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills are essential to succeed in this role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership & Oversight: Manage, train, and support AP staff, fostering a positive, supportive work environment and maintaining a team-oriented mindset to achieve collective goals. Serve as the primary resource and subject-matter expert for escalated AP issues.

  • Invoice & Workflow Management: Oversee the team's review, verification, and processing of high-volume invoices across multiple brands to ensure accurate and timely execution in accordance with company policies. Ensure the accurate entry and matching of invoices with purchase orders (POs) and receipts within Coupa and NetSuite.

  • Payment Processing Approvals: Review and approve weekly, biweekly, or monthly payment runs, which include checks, ACH, and wire transfers. Ensure all payments strictly comply with vendor terms and internal company policies.

  • Vendor & Stakeholder Relations: Act as the highest point of contact for complex vendor inquiries, ensuring prompt and professional resolution of unresolved discrepancies or outstanding balances. Partner closely with procurement, finance, and business stakeholders to resolve issues and share crucial business insights.

  • Month-End Close & Reconciliation: Lead the AP month-end close process, ensuring all AP transactions and high-volume credit card transactions are recorded and reconciled accurately.

  • Compliance & Record Keeping: Ensure organizational compliance regarding 1099 reporting and sales tax regulations. Ensure the team maintains highly accurate and organized records of all invoices, payments, and correspondence.

  • Process Improvement: Proactively identify and execute opportunities to streamline the AP process, boost efficiency, and enhance overall accuracy across the department. Lead ad hoc projects and adapt team workflows to shifting priorities when necessary.

Requirements:

  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in full cycle accounts payable, including managing high-volume invoice processing, with at least 2 years in a leadership or supervisory capacity.

  • Technical Knowledge: Strong, advanced understanding of AP workflows, internal controls, expense coding, and 3-way matching.

  • Systems Proficiency: Expert proficiency in AP and accounting systems, specifically NetSuite, Salesforce, and Coupa.

  • Software Skills: Advanced MS Excel skills, including proficiency in building vLOOKUPs and Pivot Tables.

  • Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving skills, impeccable attention to detail, and the ability to resolve discrepancies efficiently. Must possess strong time management skills to prioritize tasks effectively under pressure and the flexibility to adapt to new processes.

–

About MicroSourcing

With over 9,000 professionals across 13 delivery centers, MicroSourcing is the pioneer and largest offshore provider of managed services in the Philippines.

Our commitment to 100% YOU

MicroSourcing firmly believes that our company's strength lies in our people's diversity and talent. We are proud to foster an inclusive culture that embraces individuals of all races, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and backgrounds. We provide space for everyone, embracing different perspectives, and making room for opportunities for each individual to thrive.

At MicroSourcing, equality is not merely a slogan – it's our commitment. Our way of life. Here, we don't just accept your unique authentic self - we celebrate it, valuing every individual's contribution to our collective success and growth. Join us in celebrating YOU and your 100%!

For more information, visit

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

AI Automation & Data Platform Lead

(Build & Scale Our AI-Driven Global Sourcing Platform)

About ASC Global

ASC Global is a global independent distributor and sourcing company serving the electronic-components, computer and data-center, industrial MRO and aviation MRO markets. We source semiconductors, passive components, interconnect products, memory, computer hardware, data-center infrastructure and industrial/aviation parts from suppliers worldwide.

The Opportunity

We're building an AI-driven global sourcing and product-intelligence platform, and we need someone who can both build it and help the rest of the company put AI to work. This is a rare hybrid: part hands-on technical builder, part AI/automation lead for the business. You'll personally architect and ship a system that continuously monitors hundreds of distributor sites, broker inventories, marketplaces and manufacturer sources - identifying products, capturing pricing and availability, and matching listings to canonical parts - while also working directly with our buyers, sales, operations and leadership to find and implement practical AI use cases across the company.

This is not a role where you hand requirements to someone else and wait. You'll write the code, deploy the system, and also run the workshops that get people using it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate the crawling, data-ingestion, normalization and matching platform - handling static and JavaScript-rendered sites, PDFs, pagination and multilingual content, with full source provenance on every record

  • Design the canonical product/supplier/offer data model and the entity-resolution logic that matches listings to real parts

  • Use LLMs where they genuinely help (extraction, translation, classification) with proper evaluation, confidence thresholds and human review - never letting a model guess a price or quantity it can't find

  • Connect the platform to Zoho CRM's RFQ workflow and, downstream, QuickBooks

  • Work with Sales, Purchasing, Operations and Finance to spot other processes AI or automation can improve, turn those into real pilots, train employees to use them, and track the impact

What Success Looks Like

  • A working architecture and data model within the first 90 days

  • At least 10 sources connected with full provenance

  • Searchable, normalized product and supplier data

  • Measured matching accuracy

  • Source-health monitoring in place

  • An initial Zoho RFQ integration

  • Beyond that: measurable hours saved, faster sourcing turnaround, broader AI adoption across departments, and a documented plan for scaling to hundreds of sources

What We're Looking For

  • Five or more years of hands-on software/data-engineering experience with real production ownership of web-crawling or large-scale data-acquisition systems - not personal projects or coursework

  • Advanced Python and strong SQL

  • Experience with a production crawling framework (e.g. Scrapy) and browser automation (Playwright or Selenium) for JavaScript-rendered sites

  • Solid grounding in HTTP, rate limiting, retries, queues and failure recovery

  • Experience building normalized pipelines from messy, conflicting data, plus entity resolution / fuzzy matching / deduplication work backed by real accuracy numbers

  • Strong PostgreSQL (or similar), plus Docker and at least one major cloud platform

  • Comfortable using LLM APIs in production - structured outputs, evaluation, cost control - without treating them as a replacement for deterministic checks

  • Personally implemented an AI or automation solution inside a real company (not just used the tools), ideally across more than one department, and comfortable running training and translating business needs into requirements for other engineers

Nice to Have

  • Temporal, Dagster, Prefect or Airflow

  • OpenSearch or Elasticsearch

  • RapidFuzz, Splink or embeddings-based matching

  • Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot, QuickBooks or other ERP integrations

  • Electronic components or other complex technical catalogs

  • Prior experience as the first or lead engineer on a new platform

This role designs and orchestrates sophisticated, multi-touch journeys within automation platforms. Drawing on customer, campaign, and engagement data, it delivers increasingly relevant, personalized communications that accelerate conversion, shorten the sales cycle, and unlock greater value from existing acquisition investment. In doing so, it brings dedicated ownership and rigor to nurturing activity currently handled manually, inconsistently, or as a secondary responsibility. Operating within the Marketing team, this role partners closely with lead generation, sales, and analytics partners to build a repeatable, measurable nurturing capability that turns generated demand into sales-ready customers.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop, own, and evolve the lifecycle marketing strategy for residential and small commercial prospects across the United States and Canada, with the objective of increasing conversion, accelerating sales readiness, enhancing engagement, and maximizing return on investment.
  • Design, build, launch, and maintain automated, triggered, and behavior-based email and SMS journeys through the marketing automation platform.
  • Support lifecycle programs for multiple initiatives, identify and improve lifecycle gaps, journey leakage points, and conversion barriers.
  • Translate campaign strategies, customer insights, and business objectives into effective, personalized nurture communications, journey maps, messaging frameworks, content requirements, and customer experiences. .
  • Partner with the Insights and Analytics team to develop audience segmentation strategies and identify new personalization opportunities as customer data, technology, and platform capabilities mature.
  • Create reusable templates, modular content assets, and standardized journey components that improve scalability, consistency, and speed to market.
  • Own the strategy, and ongoing optimization of lifecycle programs within the marketing automation platform, partnering with Marketing Operations for configuration and governance.
  • Coordinate lead handoff processes, follow-up expectations, and feedback loops with Sales to ensure timely engagement and continuous improvement in lead conversion outcomes.
  • Establish and monitor lifecycle marketing KPIs, including engagement, sales acceptance, opportunity creation, sales-cycle progression, conversion rates, and revenue contribution.
  • Develop and execute a structured testing and optimization roadmap across subject lines, content, offers, timing, cadence, channels, segmentation strategies, and journey logic.
  • Partner with internal teams and agency partners to develop integrated demand generation and lead management strategies.
  • Coordinate lifecycle journeys across paid media, traditional media, websites, landing pages, email, SMS, remarketing, and sales outreach channels to deliver a seamless customer experience.

What you bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Analytics, or a related field required.
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification or equivalent marketing automation platform certification preferred
  • 5–7 years of experience developing lead nurture, lifecycle, CRM, email, or marketing automation programs.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including Journey Builder and Email Studio, building automated, segmented, and triggered customer journeys.
  • Experience supporting both U.S. and Canadian marketing programs preferred
  • Legal Authorization to work in the US is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future for this job opening.

Work Location: Candidates must be located in the Eastern or Central Time Zone in the US to be considered.

Job Title: In-Home Nurse Practitioner Per Diem - Columbia

Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Nurse Practitioner to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes
  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs
  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role
  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed
  • Conduct virtual visits as needed
  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Per diem employees qualify for:
  • Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)
  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)
  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications
  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)
  • Board certification (required)
  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

12

Part time

$37.66 - $81.11

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. We are seeking an analytical and detail-oriented individual to join our Compliance function as a Market Surveillance Analyst. This role will focus on the day-to-day monitoring and surveillance of trading activity, supporting the identification, review, and escalation of potential market conduct risks.

This is a hands-on position suited to an early- to mid-career professional with an interest in financial markets, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work with data. The role will support monitoring across equities and related products, helping ensure appropriate oversight of trading behaviour and regulatory compliance.

What You'll Do:

Transform findings into clear, user-friendly reports and dashboards using Power BI, Excel, or similar reporting tools to help escalate risks to internal stakeholders. The type of reports, the analysis and monitoring to be performed and produced will be provided by the Compliance team.

1. Monitoring and Surveillance

  • Monitor trading activity to identify potential market conduct risks.
  • Review alerts and transactions to detect unusual patterns or behaviours.
  • Investigate suspicious activity, anomalies, or outliers in client trading behaviour.
  • Support the identification and escalation of risks, including:
    • Insider trading
    • Market manipulation, including price manipulation
    • Inappropriate arbitrage activity

2. Risk and Compliance Support

  • Support the operation of surveillance and monitoring frameworks.
  • Assist in maintaining controls aligned with investment banking and capital markets activities.
  • Escalate issues or suspicious activity in a timely, structured, and documented manner.

3. Product and Activity Oversight

  • Provide support in relation to equities-related activities and transactions.
  • Assist in reviewing corporate actions, such as stock splits, from a risk and compliance perspective.
  • Work with internal teams to ensure activities align with regulatory expectations.

4. Regulatory and Operational Support

  • Support regulatory reporting and documentation as required.
  • Assist with internal audits and regulatory reviews.
  • Maintain accurate and complete records of monitoring activities, findings, and escalations.

5. Collaboration

  • Work closely with Risk, Compliance, and Product teams.
  • Develop a strong understanding of business activities to support effective monitoring and surveillance.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of monitoring processes and controls.

What You'll Need:

  • 3–4 years' experience in a role requiring strong analytical thinking, data interpretation, and report generation, preferably within financial services.
  • Experience with monitoring, transaction review, or control-based activities.
  • Comfortable working with data, alerts, and structured processes.
  • Understanding of market abuse risks, including insider trading and price manipulation is a nice to have but not a must.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

"I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

raw.description:
Novakid is an online English school for kids. The Visitor Squad owns the funnel from first visit to paid lesson: landing pages, registration and booking, blog, and the visitor's personal account. We track two key metrics, visitor → lead and visitor → booking, and test almost everything we ship through experiments.

This is a backend-first role: about 70% backend (Python, some ) and 30% frontend (React/TypeScript). You'll own the server side of the funnel: APIs behind registration, booking and the visitor account, attribution, and server-side integrations with ad platforms. When a feature needs frontend work, you'll take it end-to-end yourself. You'll work within the squad's processes: planning, grooming, code review, sprints and releases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain Python services and APIs behind the funnel: registration, booking and the visitor account

  • Build and own server-side integrations with ad platforms (Meta CAPI, TikTok Events API and similar): event delivery, deduplication, retries and monitoring

  • Own attribution on the backend: end-to-end visit tracking, UTM persistence, and diagnosing gaps in V2L/V2B data

  • Keep services fast and reliable: caching, query optimization, debugging server-side rendering in our layer

Job Title: In-Home Physician Full Time - Lima

Job Location: Work at Home, Ohio, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Health, dental and vision insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Annual CEU allowance

  • 401K

  • Supplies and other perks

  • Malpractice coverage

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours

40

Time Type

Full time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:
